notes: Copied as published by the GF180MCU PDK documentation (public page). null marks a blank cell. The page publishes pfet values with the sign of the PE2 current/voltage; see each entry's definition_note for how they map to our metrics (vt_* signed by polarity, all other metrics magnitudes).

entries.vt_definition: Not defined on the page: only the heading 'Linear Threshold Voltage' (VT0).
entries.definition_note: The page gives VT0 only the heading 'Linear Threshold Voltage' with no bias or current criterion. Compared with vt_lin_maxgm (Vds = 0.1 V, linear extrapolation at maximum gm, the textbook definition of a linear Vt), the closest of our metrics; vt_lin_cc (100 nA*W/L constant current) is shown alongside in the docs but is not the compared metric.

Idsat at |Vds| = |Vgs| = 5 V; ours is |Id|/W at |Vgs| = |Vds| = 5 V, |Vbs| = 0 (same definition). The page publishes the pfet value negative; our metric is a magnitude, so the comparison uses the absolute values.

Ioff at |Vds| = 5.5 V, 25 C; ours is Id/W at Vgs = 0, Vds = 5.5 V, 25 C (same definition). The page publishes the pfet value negative and as a one-sided limit (min only); our metric is a magnitude, so the comparison is |Ioff| <= 10 pA/um.
No BVDSS metric in our reference (breakdown is not simulated); listed for completeness, not compared.
